_comment: Tool (function-calling) definitions exposed to the LLM. Deliverable: 'LLM / LangChain tool configuration files -> Tool definitions'. The schema is Gemini's function-declaration format; the same shape maps onto LangChain StructuredTool or OpenAI tools with no semantic change.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Send the security robot to one single named location in the museum and wait until it arrives. Use this for any instruction that identifies one place to go and check.

location.description: Exact key from the museum location list. Must match one of the allowed values.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining why this location matches the operator's instruction. Shown in the console so the operator can audit the decision.

tools.name: patrol_route
tools.description: Visit several named locations in order, pausing at each. Use this when the instruction covers an area rather than a single room ('sweep the west side', 'do a full round', 'check both galleries').

locations.description: Two to eight location keys, in the order they should be visited.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the route choice.

tools.name: report_status
tools.description: Answer a question about the robot or the museum without moving. Use for 'where are you', 'what rooms exist', 'what can you do'.

answer.description: A short plain-language answer for the operator.

tools.name: reject_command
tools.description: Decline an instruction that does not correspond to any museum location or any capability the robot has. Never guess a location when the instruction is genuinely unrelated.

explanation.description: Why the instruction could not be mapped to an action.
